source: period weights: IBGE Nomes API v2 decade percentages (via ptbr_sampler/data/names_data.json); sex prior: brasil.io/genero-nomes (Álvaro Justen / @turicas), built from the public IBGE Nomes API. Mirrored at https://data.brasil.io/dataset/genero-nomes/nomes.csv.gz + Gemini gap-fill (514 rows in this partition; see docs/sources/gemini-gender-classifications.md)
derivation: weight(name, period, sex) ∝ percentage(name, period) * p_sex(name); normalised within each (period, sex).
